values.note: FS and recreation.gov say 13 sites; the catalog lists 12 bookable sites plus site 006, a management (host) site. All back-in gravel spurs; the catalog's per-site lengths (30-69 ft) run past the FS's 35-ft RV maximum.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/dearhamer-campground ('13 standard sites suitable for tents, trailers, and RVs. There is a maximum length of 35 feet for RVs.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Dearhamer CG ... 13/35'') + recreation.gov per-site catalog for 234757 (12 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, all Back-In, Max Vehicle Length 30-69; 006 MANAGEMENT), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water from a hydrant; may be off before Memorial Day and after Sept 30 (Forest note), and a Sept 9 - Oct 4, 2026 alert said there was no well water at the Ruedi campgrounds. Bear-proof food lockers at each site. The Ruedi Marina dump station is closed (nearest Silt or Edwards).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/dearhamer-campground ('vault toilets and a drinking water hydrant'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + recreation.gov 234757 notice ('Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('If site has water, it may not be available prior to Memorial Day weekend ... or after September 30th') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/alerts ('No water for campers at Ruedi Reservoir Campgrounds', Sept 9 - Oct 4, 2026; 'Ruedi Marina Day Use area Dump Station is CLOSED'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The Forest's estimated 2026 dates; opening can shift with weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates: 'Dearhamer CG ... 5/13-10/30'; 'These are estimated opening dates. Opening dates can adjust based on weather'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Concessionaire-run (American Land & Leisure). Reserved sites must be occupied the first night (held until 11 am the next day). One RV with tow per site; most sites take one extra vehicle at a nightly fee paid at the campground. Up to 14 nights a month.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234757 (rules reservationCutOff 2, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 days each month; notices 'Campers must occupy the site the first night', 'One RV with tow per single site'; rates Peak Season 2026-05-13 to 2026-10-29) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Rec.gov or FCFS: R'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov's 2026-2028 standard nonelectric rate; the Forest's 2026 sheet says $31 with 'rates differ between weekdays/weekends'. Extra vehicle charged per night at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234757/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-13 to 2026-10-29, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29; same 2027, 2028) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('$31', 'Rates differ between weekdays/weekends'), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234757 (notice 'Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Aspen-Sopris RD (White River NF), ~22 mi up Frying Pan Rd from Basalt: a small loop under cottonwoods at the head of Ruedi Reservoir where the Fryingpan River enters, ~7,800 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page + Forest 2026 operating-dates sheet + recreation.gov: 12 bookable back-in sites (13 incl. the host site), 35-ft RV max, no electric, vault toilets, water hydrant, reservable on recreation.gov to 2 days out, 14 nights/month, $29 (rec.gov 2026-28; the sheet says $31), season 5/13-10/30, senior discount. Pin is 769 m east of the site centroid (see flags). Riverfront: north-row sites ~20-40 m from the Fryingpan through a cottonwood band, west sites ~60 m from the reservoir's inlet arm - left as stored. Note trimmed of field repeats.
flags: Pin 769 m off: stored 39.3614,-106.7298 sits east of the campground; the 13 recreation.gov site points centre on 39.36092,-106.73872 (FS page and recreation.gov give 39.36088,-106.73869).

Missing phone: Aspen-Sopris Ranger District, (970) 963-2266 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices). recreation.gov's customer service line for the concessionaire (American Land & Leisure) is 801-226-3564.
Website: stored link is the recreation.gov booking page only; the FS page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/dearhamer-campground.
Fee conflict: recreation.gov $29 (2026, also 2027-28) vs the Forest's 2026 sheet $31 'rates differ between weekdays/weekends'; recorded $29.
FS page conflict: its amenity block says 'Restrooms are not available at this site' while its own description (and recreation.gov) say vault toilets; vault_toilets kept true.

Riverfront not fully re-audited: per-site points put sites 1-5 ~20-40 m from the Fryingpan channel behind a band of cottonwoods (open-apron rule unclear under canopy), sites 7-8 ~60 m from the reservoir inlet arm (which is drawn down in low water).
